description: Send a text message by thread_id (from dm_list) or username. A username never messaged before gets a new conversation, which lands in their message requests; those cold sends are capped per day. Rate-limited calls return `done: false`. The conversation is read back after the send: `confirmed: false` means Instagram took it but it does not show there (`verified: false`: the read-back failed), tell the user to check the chat before sending it again. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

force.description: True to send a new conversation past the daily cold-DM limit. Only when the user explicitly asks for it: more cold DMs raise the risk of an Instagram block.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

thread_id.description: Conversation id from dm_list. Provide this or `username`.

name: dm_send
title: DM send
